start.name: Luna Orbital Dock
start.description: Home of the Long Haul Initiative. Last chance for fair prices.

layout.name: Ceres Relay
layout.description: The last station with a Sol flag flying over it.

stations.name: Mars Freeport
stations.description: Red dust on every surface, and merchants who know you can't turn back.

stations.name: Vesta Depot
stations.description: A mining depot that sells mostly fuel and complaints.

stations.name: Pallas Trade Ring
stations.description: A busy ring station where every trader has a deal for you.

layout.name: Nix Haven
layout.description: A pirate haven carved into an ice moon. Everything is for sale.

stations.name: Halley Outpost
stations.description: A frontier outpost built into an old comet.

stations.name: Eris Fuel Stop
stations.description: One pump, one cook, one very bored attendant.

layout.name: Lantern Waystation
layout.description: A monastery-station. The monks trade supplies and ask nothing but your story.

stations.name: Sedna Mission
stations.description: A tiny mission station, glad of any visitor.

stations.name: Deepwell Station
stations.description: The deepest station humans have built. The prices show it.

stations.name: Approach Beacon Depot
stations.description: An automated depot left by the survey mission. It still takes credits.
